notes.title: v1.0 - Early Look: The Laser Gun
notes.notes:
[b]Finishing up our trinity of new weapon videos, we have a very unique addition to the set![/b]

Through a clever use of magnifying glasses and lenses, this next weapon can accurately burst balloons from across the map!

Unfortunately, having a steady stream of concentrated sunlight shooting from the tip of your weapon has the undesirable side effect of drawing everyone's eyes to you. So be warned, only use this weapon if you're looking for all out war!

Presenting: The Laser Gun!

https://youtu.be/3MnGl51HRGU
https://sketchfab.com/models/30a8f16fe7144020ad33b687d47699f4

notes.title: v1.0 - Early Look: The Nail Gun
notes.notes:
Continuing our stream of early looks into the v1.0 update of Balloon Chair Death Match, we're excited to present the ultimate balloon popper:

The Nail Gun!

https://youtu.be/hfWjckfXqfc
https://sketchfab.com/models/9766a4920e2544bba4773ddf02201c2f

Shooting hundreds of nails a minute, the Nail Gun is a devastating mixture of extreme air pressure, and little sharp bits of metal. 

Like the Pistol's far more energetic older brother, the Nail Gun has the unique ability to shoot through multiple balloons with a single shot!

Watch your opponent's smirking face suddenly drop when they see you pull this mighty weapon from it's holster!

notes.title: Coming Soon - The Pigeon Launcher & v1.0!!!
notes.notes:
[b]There's been some extreme sciencing going on in the BCDM studio these past months! Finally we can start to reveal what insane creations we've come up with![/b]

We've been hard at work to develop the ultimate BCDM v1.0 update which will see us leave Early Access! It'll include new weapons, game modes, pickups, single player levels and a whole lot more, so it's sure to feel like a completely different and hugely improved game!

More on that later, for today we want to show you one of three new weapons being introduced in the v1.0 update.

Feast your eyes on The Pigeon Launcher!!!

https://youtu.be/1Xj5GfLVGCY
Armed with some of the greatest homing pigeon technology, the Pigeon Launcher will hunt down enemy balloons in the local area and burst whole clumps of them!

But be warned, homing pigeon tech doesn't come cheap so you won't have a lot of ammo!

https://sketchfab.com/models/0dfb2cec4ebb49f39f5f65a0987b412e

notes.title: v0.3.2 - OUT NOW! New Map, New Missions, Improved Controls!
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/iUkNNqTTYnA

[b]---------------------------------------- New Campaign Map ----------------------------------------[/b]

Neotopia! 
City of light and colour! 
A whole new campaign map with new missions and higher difficulty!

> Neotopia comes with three new missions (more being added later!)

> Neotopia maps are higher difficulty than the existing Floatonia City maps

> The third map introduces the shotgun (The Red Devil) as the first campaign alternative weapon!

> Multiplayer and achievements specifically for Neotopia will be introduced in later updates


[b]---------------------------------------- Control Improvements ----------------------------------------[/b]

We've made a number of improvements to the controls so that your balloon flying experience is that much smoother!

> Auto-grip in the joystick is now active by default so new players aren't forced to keep it gripped at all times. If you preferred the old control scheme, you can change it back from the options menu

> To inflate balloons, you now only need to press the inflate button once rather than hold it down for two seconds. You can still hold it down to inflate one  balloon after another, or you can tap it each time a balloon is inflated


[b]----------------------------------------------------- Balance -----------------------------------------------------[/b]

The Shotgun felt more like a permanent weapon than a short-term super-powered gun. So we've balanced things out to reduce the amount of time player spend with it, but increase how powerful it is overall.

> The Shotgun's range, number of bullets fired and spread have all been increased

> The Shotgun now only holds a maximum of 20 shells (down from 30)

> The Shotgun now only receives 10 shells from the big pickup

> The Shotgun now only receives 6 shells from the little pickup

notes.title: New Singleplayer Campaign is NOW LIVE! + 50% Discount, Achievements, Comfort Settings and MORE!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/E8HnCfo.jpg]

The new Single Player Campaign (Update v0.3) is now live and to celebrate:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/498990/][b]GET BALLOON CHAIR DEATH MATCH NOW FOR 50% OFF![/b][/url]

But if you've already got the game, jump on in and try out the biggest update BCDM has had to date! A fluid, linear campaign system with both laid back balloon popping missions, and some very challenging challenges and achievements!

If you've not yet read the patch notes, you can see them in full below!

[b]---------------------------------------- New Campaign Mode ----------------------------------------[/b]

Brand new Single-Player Campaign mode with a linear mission system!

> Five core missions and two challenge missions in the first map, Floatonia City

> Each mission has a target score to achieve a bronze, silver and gold medal

> Score at least a bronze on a core mission to unlock the next one

> Core missions are designed to be fun, but also help the player get into the gameplay and understand the controls more naturally

> Getting a bronze is relatively easy and most players should be able to achieve it in a few tries

> However gold medals are very difficult to obtain, so focus and make sure not to miss the 100 point balloon!

> Challenge missions are unlocked by getting silver medals on certain missions

> Challenge missions are intentionally difficult and represent a real challenge for even skilled players

> Complete all five core missions to unlock new maps which will be released in subsequent updates!


[b]---------------------------------------- Comfort Settings ----------------------------------------[/b]

> The comfort settings are now out of beta and are full release!

> Press 1 on your keyboard to activate the [url=http://i.imgur.com/BZr5mOs.png]field-of-view reducing vignette[/url]

> Press 2 on your keyboard to activate the [url=http://i.imgur.com/ynBwqDI.png]frame-of-reference bubble[/url]

> If you feel discomfort in the game, try each of these, then both. During our testing we found that everyone who previously felt discomfort was able to play the game for a long time with one of the comfort settings enabled.


[b]---------------------------------------- Recenter Button ----------------------------------------[/b]

> If you get into a battle and you're not centred on the chair, or you want to move the location of the chair, you can do so.

> Pressing the recenter button will reset  the position of your chair to where ever you currently are

> On Vive, the recenter button is the grip button on the left controller

> On Rift, the recenter button is Y (on the left controller)

[b]---------------------------------------- New Achievements ----------------------------------------[/b]

Loads of new achievements to collect while you progress through the Campaign!

> Unlock achievements by... achieving various feats of skill!

> Check the achievements window above the mission select screen to see which achievements you have or have not received so far on that map

> Achievements include getting gold on every mission on a map, surviving for a certain amount of waves in survival mode and many more


[b]---------------------------------------- New Menu Flow ----------------------------------------[/b]

An easy to understand menu structure replacing the old, confusing menus.

> Front-loaded main menu with Campaign front and centre

> New campaign interface shows you how progression functions through an easy to understand web of missions and challenges

> Mission panel explains the content of a mission, the points necessary for each medal and whether or not it's currently unlocked


[b]---------------------------------------- Other ----------------------------------------[/b]

> The gas gauge is now further forward and higher up to make seeing it a lot easier!

notes.title: v0.2.1 NOW LIVE! - Comfort Settings Beta!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/ZLtIFlN.png]

[b]--------------------------------------- Comfort Settings Beta ---------------------------------------[/b]

Some players gave us feedback that they were feeling discomfort while playing BCDM so we wanted to get together some basic comfort settings as quickly as possible to see if they helped.

We've tested out the comfort settings on some of our [strike]lab rats[/strike] colleagues in the studio and we've had a lot of success with even the most extreme cases of VR discomfort finding themselves being able to play several games of BCDM without any problem!

There are two types of comfort setting in BCDM. The reduced Field of View Vignette and the Frame of Reference cage.

[b]Reduced Field of View Vignette[/b]
You can activate the reduced Field of View Vignette by pressing the 1 key on your keyboard at any point during a battle. Pressing it a second time removes the vignette.

The vignette limits a player's field of view which can be one of the major causes of discomfort for some. The below image isn't entirely representative of what you see with the headset on, but you get the idea :)

[img=http://i.imgur.com/BZr5mOs.png]


[b]Frame of Reference 'Cage'[/b]
Nope it's not Nicolas Cage acting as your frame of reference. The frame of reference cage creates a solid frame that sits around your chair to act as a frame of reference while you move your head around in VR.

You can activate the Frame of Reference Cage by pressing the 2 key on your keyboard at any point during a battle. Pressing it a second time removes the cage.

Having a frame of reference is all some people need for their brains to understand how objects are moving relative to them in VR and can deal with a lot of the discomfort.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/ynBwqDI.png]


For both of the above comfort settings, please be aware that different people suffer from VR discomfort for different reasons. If you feel discomfort, try one of the two, then try the other, then try both.

Once you've done that please give us your feedback on whether the settings improved your experience at any one of these channels:
Discord - https://discord.gg/JwYYbk9
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/balloonchairdeathmatch
Twitter - https://twitter.com/OfficialBCDM
Reddit - https://www.reddit.com/r/BCDM/


[b]----------------------------------- Other-----------------------------------[/b]

> Big ammo/gas pickups no longer require you to be at the correct height. Touching any part of the vertical beam will automatically collect the pickup (this is not currently the case with weapon pickups)

notes.title: v0.2 NOW LIVE! - Survival Mode, Shotgun and more!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/JZuAePR.png]

THE NEW UPDATE IS NOW LIVE! JUMP ON AND PLAY TO YOUR HEART'S CONTENT!

v0.2 brings with it a whole new singleplayer and multiplayer gamemode: Survival mode, a whole new weapon for those game modes: The shotgun (a.k.a. The Red Devil), a recenter view button and much more!

[b]---------------------------------------- New Survival Mode ----------------------------------------[/b]

https://youtu.be/vqCC_v4064k
Survival mode, where not just your accuracy but your positioning and endurance are put to the test! Survive for as long as you can against increasingly difficult foes to get as many points as possible!

> As per traditional Survival Mode gameplay, the player or players are opposed by wave after wave of increasingly difficult enemies

> Gameplay is balanced for playing solo, two players, three players or four players

> The goal is to survive as long as possible and kill as many enemies as possible

> Early waves have few enemies, each equipped with few balloons and no gas

> Later waves will have far more enemies, each equipped with anything up to nine balloons and a full tank of gas! Be warned, they also become much more accurate at shooting you as time goes on!

> Score is awarded for shooting balloons (15 points), killing enemies (200 points), assisting the kill of an enemy (100 points) and grabbing pickups (50 points)

> Available in Singleplayer and Multiplayer

> Supports up to four players in Multiplayer

[b]--------------------------------------- New Shotgun: The Red Devil ---------------------------------------[/b]

https://youtu.be/DUl7pmzeWvk
The Red Devil - A twin-barrelled sawn-off shotgun will be the first new weapon introduced into Balloon Chair Death Match since launch!

> Can be obtained by finding and making contact with the pickup (look for the beam of red light in the sky!)

> Shoots a spread of ten bullets with each shot

> Can fire twice before needing to reload

> Extremely strong in close to medium range - Can demolish a fully inflated nine-balloon player!

> Has a limited range so it can't shoot as far as the pistol

> Swaps back to the pistol when it runs out of ammo

> Bloody satisfying to fire at a clump of enemies in survival mode >:D

[b]----------------------------------- New Challenge: Shooting Range-----------------------------------[/b]

A new challenge mode has been added to the challenges menu!

> The new challenge introduces a new mechanic to BCDM: Shooting Ranges

> Shooting Ranges are indicated by a red ring, similar to the gold navigational rings

> When you make contact with a Shooting Range ring, you immediately stop moving and a countdown begins

> You can shoot balloons that spawn in front of you to quicken the rate at which the countdown ends, essentially maximizing your score

> When the countdown ends, a set of balloons will appear for a limited time

> Shooting all the balloons in a set causes the next set to spawn

> Once all the sets have ended, you get access to your movement controls again and the challenge can continue

[b]----------------------------------- Other Changes -----------------------------------[/b]

> Balloon Cloud: A new option in the Tutorials sub-category of Single Player. Spend three minutes casually flying around the city shooting some balloons. Great for target practice or just a casual fly around the city

> A re-center button has been added to the HTC Vive controls. During a battle, press the left-hand's inner grip button to reset the position of the chair relative to your position. Note: The Rift already has this functionality with the Y button

> The menu structure has been completely re-worked to allow for easier navigation, many more challenges and many more single/multiplayer game modes

> Bot AI and pathing has been improved overall with more improvements planned for future updates

> Fixed a bug that caused Vive users to spawn under their chair if a Rift user is hosting a match

[b]Coming this Thursday! The Red Devil![/b]

As part of a content-packed update coming this Thursday, a twin-barrelled sawn-off shotgun known as "The Red Devil" will be making its way into Balloon Chair Death Match!

But be warned, its short range and wide spread makes it inferior to the pistol in long-range fights.

notes.title: VR Gaming Night was a MASSIVE SUCCESS!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who turned up for the VR Gaming Night!
Although we originally said we'd stop giving away keys at 1,000, you lot were just so excited that we couldn't stop there and ended up giving away around 2,000 keys in total!!!

Whether you contacted us through Steam, Reddit, Discord or Facebook, we want to thank everyone who participated in some awesome VR multiplayer action!

It brings warmth to my heart to see one of our devs being shot out the sky by new members of our community <3

We've got some great new content coming to BCDM throughout the next month so hopefully you'll stay with us and try your hand at it all.

For those of you who felt discomfort due to the control scheme, I want you to know that we're considering comfort options a high priority and will make sure we prioritize them as much as we realistically can (remember we only have two programmers!).

> Score is awarded for shooting balloons (15 points), killing enemies (200 points), assisting the kill of an enemy (100 points) and grabbing pickups (50 points)

[b]----------------------------------- New Challenge Mode -----------------------------------[/b]

A new challenge mode has been added to the challenges menu!

> The new challenge introduces a new mechanic to BCDM: Shooting Ranges

> Shooting Ranges are indicated by a red ring, similar to the gold navigational rings

> When you make contact with a Shooting Range ring, you immediately stop moving and a countdown begins

> You can shoot balloons that spawn in front of you to quicken the rate at which the countdown ends, essentially maximizing your score

> When the countdown ends, a set of balloons will appear for a limited time

> Shooting all the balloons in a set causes the next set to spawn

> Once all the sets have ended, you get access to your movement controls again and the challenge can continue

[b]----------------------------------- Other Changes -----------------------------------[/b]

> The menu structure has been completely re-worked to allow for easier navigation, many more challenges and many more single/multiplayer game modes

> Bot AI and pathing has been improved overall with more improvements planned for future updates

notes.title: Challenge Mode Update! - Version 0.1.300
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/ve6KxhM.png]

[b]The AI Bot Challenge Mode update is now live![/b]

In this update we have the introduction of AI enemies into the existing challenge modes to form the new challenge modes. This is our first foray into having AI enemies in challenge modes and we'll be watching player feedback closely so make your voice heard!

We hope you enjoy this mid-month mini update as the BCDM team work hard to bring you a much larger update coming at the end of this month!

Want to give feedback?
Chat on Discord: https://discord.gg/JwYYbk9
Post on Twitter: https://twitter.com/OfficialBCDM
Post on Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/BCDM/

You can read the exact changes below! 

[b]----------------------------------------- NEW CHALLENGE MODE #3 & #4 -------------------------------- [/b]
A far harder version of the existing challenge modes, these new challenges include infinitely re-spawning AI enemies who will come at you again and again!

Unlike deathmatch mode, when you die the challenge is immediately ended so ignoring them is not an option.

Once defeated, the AI enemy will respawn further down the map and after a 7 second delay, will begin hunting you anew.

However, skilled players who find the first two challenge modes too easy will be able to rack up a far higher score as each AI balloon popped earns you 15 points and each kill earns you 200 points!


[b]------------------------------------------------------- OTHER ----------------------------------------------------- [/b]
We have reduced the 30 second wait after each challenge mode down to a 10 second wait as we found it too long when you just wanted to try again.

notes.title: Bots & Challenge Mode Update! - Version 0.1.200
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/8sgBjIZ.png]

The Bots & Challenge Mode Update is now live! We're very proud to introduce our first ever update for Balloon Chair Death Match with many many more to come! 

You can read the exact changes below!

----------------------------------------- [b]NEW DEATHMATCH BOTS[/b] -------------------------------------------
With it comes an all new bots system to either populate multiplayer games with, or to just play deathmatch solo against the AI!

To use the bots, simply go into a multiplayer game as host and press "Start game with bots". This will fill all empty player slots with bots! So if you're alone in the lobby, you'll end up playing against three bots. If you're in there with one other player, the two of you will enter a deathmatch with two bots etc..

However the "Start game" button still exists if you don't want bots in your game!


---------------------------------------- [b]NEW CHALLENGE MODE MAP[/b] ---------------------------------------
A new challenge mode map can now be accessed via the challenge mode menu! The new map focuses far more on vertical movement and manoeuvrability, so you'll likely find it's far more challenging than the first map!

The challenge map also comes with it's own leader board, seperate to that of challenge mode #1.


---------------------------------- [b]SCREEN RECORDING IMPROVEMENTS[/b] ---------------------------------
We've made improvements to the monitor display for Balloon Chair Death Match to make it easier to record your screen, or just make it easier for your friend to watch you play :)

On both the HTC Vive and the Oculus Rift you'll now get a full field-of-view display of what  the player is seeing.

Previously, the Rift showed to mirrored two-eye view, and the Vive showed a single narrow view.


We the team of Balloon Chair Death Match hope you enjoy the new update and look forward to bringing you loads of great new stuff in the new year!

Until then, have a good holiday and a happy new year!

notes.title: Looking for Games - Using Discord
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've currently got a few different things going on to make multiplayer games consistent. Some focused on promoting the game to get more players in, others are more development focused like basic bots.

But until that's sorted I wanted to make it as easy as possible to schedule games with other players. One good option is to use Highdroid's thread located here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/498990/discussions/0/152391995419317272/

Another option is to use the new BCDM Discord server to speak with other players and devs to organise games. We have a channel specifically for organising games and letting other players know when you're available to play. If you already know how Discord works, you can join us here:
https://discord.gg/JwYYbk9

_____________________________________________________________________

If you don't know how Discord works, you can think of it as a more gamer friendly version of Skype. You can download the desktop app or simply login through your web browser:
https://discordapp.com/

I've written a quick explanation on how it works below:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/8nPJ3B5.png]

1. Server list. You can have multiple servers here which you switch between simply by clicking on them.

2. Text channels. These are the different areas you can chat in, similar to sub-forums. Some you will see like #public and #lookingforgames, and some you won't see because of privileges like #devchat being only for devs.

3. Voice channels. We don't currently have them set up but if there's interest, we can set up voice channels so that players can be on voice comms with each other during games too.

4. Chat area. This is where you type and talk with other players in your currently selected text channel.

5. Member list. These are all the members that are currently in the text channel you have selected. Keep in mind that you're universally 'in' all text channels that you have access to across all servers so you don't disappear from #lookingforgames when you click on #public for example.

It's actually a lot easier to understand than all of the above and you get used to it very quickly :) So whether you're looking to organise games, or just want to come hang out, come join the BCDM Discord server!

Just click on an empty server button on the left, select join server and use this URL:
https://discord.gg/JwYYbk9
